A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Registration is open to all, of all nationalities.

Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.

We ask for punctuality and recommend competitors to arrive at least 15 minutes before any event in which they wish to participate.

We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Nanaimo, B.C., for the Nanaimo Back to School 2022 cubing competition. It's been a little while since we've seen cubing competitions in B.C., and we're thrilled to be one of the teams bringing cubers back together again to compete, connect, and have fun! 

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. 

Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed.

We look forward to a full house of 65 competitors!

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests.

Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule - for events in the afternoon (4x4x4 and onwards), **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

items.name: Gdańsk Open 2022
items.information:
Gdański Speedcubing wraca do akcji! Po wielu miesiącach stagnacji wywołanej pandemią, z nowymi siłami i w nowym składzie wracamy do boju! Tym razem spotkamy się w gdańskiej szkole Podstawowej nr 48, w której już w 2015 roku walczyliśmy w kilkunastu konkurencjach WCA. Tym razem zmierzymy się zaledwie w 8 najpopularniejszych konkurencjach, ale przeprowadzimy aż 23 rundy startowe! 

---

Speedcubing in Gdańsk is coming back! After many months of pandemic stagnation we are coming back with new strength and new people! This time we will be meeting in Primary School no. 48, where we had a competition back in 2015. This time we will be solving only 8 events but there will be 23 rounds!

🏆 "Madryn al Cubo II 2022" contará con **8 categorias** (2x2 - 3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - FMC - Pyraminx - A una mano 3x3 - Megaminx) y **14 rondas** en total. El objetivo es que los competidores de la región puedan actualizar sus tiempos y seguir mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado el [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019), [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) y el [Madryn al Cubo 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MadrynAlCubo2022) con gran éxito. El cupo maximo de competidores será de 50, pudiéndose anotar a todas las categorías que deseen pagando 1 sola inscripción. **Se ruega puntualidad**. Recomendamos llegar 15 minutos antes de cada ronda en la que vas a competir.

❗ ¡Seguinos en [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/octo_cubos/) para estar al día de todas las novedades del Torneo!

🇺🇸 *ENGLISH*
🏆"Madryn al Cubo II 2022" will feature **8 categories** (2x2 - 3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - FMC - Pyraminx - One Handed - Megaminx) and **14 rounds** in total. The goal is that the competitors in the region can update their times and continue to improve. We have the experience of having organized [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019), [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) and [Madryn al Cubo 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MadrynAlCubo2022) with great success. The maximum capacity of competitors will be 50. You will be able to sign up for all the events paying only 1 registration. **Punctuality is necessary**. We recommend arriving 15 minutes before each round in which you are going to compete.

❗ Follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/octo_cubos/) to keep up with the news about the Tournament!

items.information:
# 🇺🇾
NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 50 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Leer toda la información disponible en esta página.

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

# 🇬🇧
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 50.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)).
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* Read all the information available in this website.

Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information:
8/21に行われるYoga Summer A 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) と8/28に行われる[Yoga Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerB2022) (以下、B大会) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。
### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。
**A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (2ラウンド) / ピラミンクス / 3x3x3 目隠し / 4x4x4 目隠し / 5x5x5 目隠し**
B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 2x2x2 キューブ / 4x4x4 キューブ / メガミンクス 

新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。
飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。

会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。
競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。**
また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。

Yoga Summer A 2022 (**This competition, A**) and [Yoga Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerB2022) (B) are WCA Series Competitions. 
### You can register either of these series competitions.  
If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected.

Please make sure that the events for A and B are different.
**A: 3x3x3 Cube (2 round) / Pyraminx / 3x3x3 blindfolded / 4x4x4 blindfolded / 5x5x5 blindfolded**
B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 2x2x2 Cube / 4x4x4 Cube / Megaminx 

The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure.
**Spectators are only permitted as companions of competitors.**
Being mindful of space, we require that **each competitor bring at most 1 guest.**
If the number of requests would become too many,  a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors)

items.information:
Bienvenidos al Abierto del Mirador 2022, nos complace traerles nuevamente un torneo a la Provincia de Buenos Aires. Nuestro evento contará con 10 categorías oficiales de la WCA distribuidas en 17 rondas.
Solo se harán devoluciones del total del pago ($1000) a quienes estén en lista de espera una vez lleno el cupo de 60 competidores siempre y cuando se confirme que no asistirán al torneo antes del mismo, no se harán devoluciones luego del evento.
Se aceptarán los registros por orden de llegada del e-mail correspondiente con comprobante a la casilla de correo del organizador.
Pedimos que dentro de las posibilidades se atienda al torneo con un (1) acompañante por cuestiones de espacio físico en el lugar del torneo.
Pedimos puntualidad a todos y recomendamos llegar al menos 15 minutos antes de cualquier categoría en la que el competidor vaya a participar.

Welcome to Abierto del Mirador 2022, we are pleased to bring you again a tournament to the Province of Buenos Aires. Our competition will feature 10 official WCA events distributed in 17 rounds.
Refunds of the total payment ($1000) will only be made to those who are on the waiting list once the quota of 60 competitors is filled as long as it is confirmed that they will not attend the tournament beforehand, no refunds will be made after the event.
Registrations will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis with proof of receipt to the organizer's e-mail address.
We ask to attend, within the possibilities, with a maximum of one (1) companion for reasons of physical space at the tournament site.
We ask for punctuality to all and recommend to arrive at least 15 minutes before any category in which the competitor will participate.

This is a series competition with [Pittsburgh Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PittsburghSummerB2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Pittsburgh Summer B 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected.
# Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.
# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:
##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, July 30th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
##### **OR** 
##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, August 9th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. 
#### 
##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted.

8 años después de nuestra última competición, os presentanos el Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. 
Un torneo de speedcubing en esta maravillosa isla del mediterraneo donde podrás disfrutar de 2 días de competicion con rondas de casi todas las categorías oficiales, que se realizarán en el mismo hotel en que podrás hospedarte.
En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. 
¡Os estaremos esperando!


8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. 
A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. 
In the 2014 edition we had up to 6 different nationalities, and we plan to overcome it this year.
So don't be afraid to join us.
We'll be waiting for you!

Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach World Cube Association.

---

Polish Speedcubing Championship is the most important event of the year of every Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it continues to attract best competitors who compete for national titles in all events sanctioned by World Cube Association.

After successful 2021 edition this year's championship will be held in a special place - Olivia Star! Once again competing at the highest level will be accompanied by amazing views from 34th floor of Olivia Star building - highest scyscraper in northern Poland!

NZ South Island Championship 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2022 is the first regional championship of 2022 in the lead up to Nationals later in 2022.

Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015!

venue.address: Stade Maurice Chevalier, 661 allée Louis Metrat, 84700 Sorgues, France

items.information:
Dans un soucis de satisfaire le plus grand nombre de personnes, nous souhaitons proposer - aux personnes inscrites en liste d'attente - les places des compétiteurs qui ne seraient pas venus.
Nous ne saurons avec précision le nombre de places libres que juste avant le tutoriel pour les nouveaux compétiteurs : dimanche à 9h00 nous regarderons donc si des personnes ne se sont pas présentées, et nous proposerons ces places aux personnes de la liste d'attente présentes, dans l'ordre de leur inscription.
Si vous êtes sur liste d'attente vous pouvez venir dimanche matin au cas où une place se libère, mais nous ne pouvons pas garantir que vous pourrez participer, et l'accès à la salle se fera en fonction de l'affluence.

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**; bien que très longues. Elles contiennent beaucoup d'informations très utiles.


----

Since we want to make as many competitors happy as we can, we would like to offer - to the competitors on the waiting list - the spots of the registered competitors who didn't show up.
We can only be sure about the number of no-shows at the beginning of the tutorial for new competitors : therefore on Sunday at 9:00, if spots are available, we will offer them to the people on the waiting list, in their registration order.
If you are on the waiting list you can come on sunday morning in case a spot is free, but we can't guarantee that you will be able to participate.

Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**, although they are very long. They contain a lot of very useful information.

items.name: Cloverdale Open 2022
items.information:
We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Cloverdale, B.C., for the Cloverdale Open 2022 cubing competition. It's been a little while since we've seen cubing competitions in B.C., and we're thrilled to be one of the teams bringing cubers back together again to compete, connect, and have fun! 

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. 

We'll be raising funds for the [Cloverdale Community Kitchen](https://www.mycck.ca), an organization that feeds the hungry, and provides care for individuals when they are struggling. Their vision is to help Cloverdale/Surrey/Langley be a healthy and caring community for everyone. 
10% of registration fees will be donated to the Cloverdale Community Kitchen. 

Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** Email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes. 

We look forward to a full house of 60 competitors!

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests.

items.information:
Dans un soucis de satisfaire le plus grand nombre de personnes, nous souhaitons proposer - aux personnes inscrites en liste d'attente - les places des compétiteurs qui ne seraient pas venus.
Nous ne saurons avec précision le nombre de places libres que juste avant le premier tour du 3x3 : dimanche à 9h15 nous regarderons donc si des personnes ne se sont pas présentées, et nous proposerons ces places aux personnes de la liste d'attente présentes, dans l'ordre de leur inscription.
Si vous êtes sur liste d'attente vous pouvez venir dimanche matin au cas où une place se libère, mais nous ne pouvons pas garantir que vous pourrez participer, et l'accès à la salle se fera en fonction de l'affluence.


Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**, elles contiennent beaucoup d'informations très utiles. 
En raison de la situation sanitaire, cette compétition aura un déroulement différent d'une compétition habituelle. Merci de **lire attentivement l'onglet [COVID-19](#18846-covid-19)** pour plus d'informations.

----

Since we want to make as many competitors happy as we can, we would like to offer - to the competitors on the waiting list - the spots of the registered competitors who didn't show up.
We can only be sure about the number of no-shows at the beginning of the 3x3 first round: therefore on Sunday at 9:15, if spots are available, we will offer them to the people on the waiting list, in their registration order, and those who are here will be able to compete in 3x3.

If you are on the waiting list you can come in case a spot opens up, but we can't guarantee you will be able to compete, and entering the competition area will be possible only if there is enough room left.
Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**, they contain a lot of very useful information.
Because of the sanitary situation, this competition will not look like an usual competition. **Please read the [COVID-19](#18846-covid-19) tab carefully** for more information.

items.information:
# 🇺🇾
NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* Recomendamos que se asista con **máximo un acompañante**, ya que no podemos asegurar que haya suficientes lugares para que todos se puedan sentar.
* Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Leer toda la información disponible en esta página.

**¡Importante!**

**La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.**

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

# 🇬🇧
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* It is strongly recommended to bring a maximum of **one guest per competitor**, given that there will not be enough seats for everyone.
* Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)).
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* Read all the information available in this website.

**Attention!**

**The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.**

Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information:
Please register for the competition via the World Cube Association website before attending the competition in order to speed up the registration process on the day. Also note that the competitor limit is set at **100 competitors**. Please register early in order to secure your place in the competition. We are allowing on-the-day registrations but please be aware that if you arrive on the day without registering and/or paying for your entry ticket, we cannot guarantee that you will be able to compete if the competitor limit has been reached.

Entry fee for the competition with be R200.00. Please pay online at Speedcubes using the following URL: https://www.speedcubes.co.za/19-competitions. Please note that we will not confirm your registration until you have paid for your entry ticket! Please email Proof of Payment to maverickpearson@gmail.com, and include in the email the FULL NAME of the competitor that the entry ticket was purchased for.

Also note that Covid protocols will be in place. Each competitor and vistors will be required to wear face masks and to sanitise regularly.

We will be releasing a Judging, Running and Scrambling video and potentially hosting an in-person tutorial before the competition date in order to familiarise both competitors and spectators who wish to volunteer with running the competition. We will be requiring everyone who wishes to judge or scramble to watch the video and attend the tutorial, especially if you are less than 12 years old or are a new competitor. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly.

Due to the school hall's capacity, we are limiting each competitor to a maximum of 4 visitors/spectators, who can attend for free.

The organiser and sponsor for the event is Speedcubes.co.za and there will be a limited number of cubes for sale on the day.

items.name: Gauteng Autumn 2022

venue.name: [Fayview Function Venue](https://fayview.com/)
venue.address: 152 President Boshoff Rd, Rynfield AH, Benoni, 1501

items.information:
## Registration

Please register for the competition via the World Cube Association website before attending the competition in order to speed up the registration process on the day. Also note that the competitor limit is set at **100 competitors**. Please register and pay early in order to secure your place in the competition. We are allowing on-the-day registrations but please be aware that if you arrive on the day without registering and/or paying for your entry ticket, we cannot guarantee that you will be able to compete if the competitor limit has been reached.

Tickets to compete start at **R 200.00**. Please pay online at https://fayview.com/product/wca-gauteng-autumn-participant/. Please note that we will not confirm your registration until you have paid for your entry ticket! 

Three ticket types are available:

- **R 200** allows you to compete in the competition.
- **R 250** allows you to compete, and also allows you access to a VIP lounge with non-alcoholic drinks and finger foods throughout the day, as well as couches, seating and a TV screen displaying results.
- **R 450** includes both of the above, and also includes a competition T-Shirt.


## Guests

Tickets for spectators are available here: https://fayview.com/product/wca-gauteng-autumn-spectator/

- **R 25** ticket will allow you access to the main competition area as a spectator.
- **R 100** will also allow you access to the VIP lounge.
- **R 300** includes both of the above, and also includes a competition T-Shirt.


## Other Information

Also note that Covid protocols will be in place. Each competitor and vistors will be required to wear face masks and to sanitise regularly.

The competition is sponsored by Speedcubes.co.za, and some puzzles will be available for sale at the competition.

items.information:
[FR]

En accord avec la politique de santé publique et les directives de l'ÉTS, tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront porter un masque à l'intérieur des bâtiments. Le port du couvre-visage en tissu est interdit. Dans l'éventualité où les directives changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.

Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet Santé & Sécurité.

**Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, vous devez réserver votre place sur le [portail de réservation](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) dans monÉTS dans la section "Activités de la vie étudiante". Vous devez enregistrer au plus tard le vendredi 15 avril à 15h. Une fois que c'est fait j'aurais la liste des étudiants qui n'auront pas besoin de payer. Vous devez donc ensuite vous inscrire sur le site web WCA en même temps que tout le monde, simplement vous n'aurez pas à payer les frais d'inscription. Je précise que vous devez enregister le plus tôt possible, car être enregistré sur le portail de réservation ne vous garantie pas une place dans la compétition.

Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée.

[EN]

As per the current public health policy and the directives of the university, all competitors and their guest must wear a mask at all time inside the buildings. Wearing a cloth mask is prohibited. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the regulations change. 

Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab.

**ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, you must reserve your place on the [reservation portal](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) on monÉTS in the "Activités de la vie étudiante" section. You must register there by Friday, April 15 at 15h. Once you register there I will have the list of students who do not need to pay. You can then register on the WCA site without paying the fee. You should register as quickly as possible, as being registered on the monÉTS portal does not guarantee you a place in the competition.

There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

"Madryn al Cubo 2022" contará con **7 categorias** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) y **11 rondas** en total. El objetivo es que los competidores de la region puedan actualizar sus tiempos y seguir mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado el [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019)  y el [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) con gran éxito. El cupo maximo de competidores será de 25, con **1 acompañante como maximo** (padre, madre, hermano, tutor, amigo, etc) pudiendose anotar a todas las categorias que deseen pagando 1 sola inscripcion. **Se ruega puntualidad**. Recomendamos llegar 15 minutos antes de cada ronda en la que vas a competir.

*ENGLISH*
"Madryn al Cubo 2022" will feature **7 categories** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) and **11 rounds** in total. The objective is that the competitors in the region can update their times and continue to improve. We have the experience of having organized [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019) and [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) with great success. The maximum capacity of competitors will be 25, with a **maximum of 1 companion** (father, mother, brother, guardian, friend, etc.) being able to enter all the categories that they wish by paying only 1 registration. **Punctuality is necessary**. We recommend arriving 15 minutes before each round in which you are going to compete.

items.information:
# REGISTRO

A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:

1.	Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição;
2.	Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
3.	Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
4.	Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 25,00 (inscrição+camiseta) pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato.
Conta para deposito: Banco Itau | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01.
5.	Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org).

O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou  teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. Essas regras podem ser mais restritas ou flexibilizadas conforme orientações dos órgãos governamentais até a data do evento.

------------

**REGISTRATION**

The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:

1.	Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer;
2.	Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
3.	Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
4.	Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed.
Bank Account:  Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01.
5.	For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email  (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org).

Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. These rules may be changed to be more restrictive or flexible based upon governmental mandates until the event date.

items.information:
Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. 

Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab.

**Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves
**Day 2:**  5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks
**Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb

Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis.

Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. 

All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:

1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

OR

2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

**Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. These circumstances include the following: **
* **Competitor contracts COVID-19 within 14 days of the competition and must withdraw**
* **Other Injury or Sickness that would prevent the competitor from attending**
* **Competition as a whole is cancelled**
* **Any specific excuse deemed acceptable by an organizer or delegate**
**We understand that some may need to cancel their registration after the refund date due to unforseen events or circumstances; however, due to financial constraints, we will only be refunding competitors if they meet one of the previously mentioned conditions. We thank you for your understanding.**

**Costa Rica Regresa V2 2022** será la primera competencia oficial despues de la pandemia en el país.

Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA.

**A las personas que estaban inscritas en Costa Rica Regresa (v1) se les solicita hacer el registro lo más rápido posible **

Por tal motivo se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia.
El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.
Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años.
Solo se permitirá un acompañante por persona.
Cada competidor deberá llevar su propio lapicero.
Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio.

**.....................English version...................**

Costa Rica Regresa V2 2022 will be the first official competition after the pandemic in the country.

Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA.


For this reason, the temperature will be taken at the entrance of the competition.
The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition.
Vaccination card will be requested from those over 12 years of age. 
We will only allow one companion per person. 
Each competitor must bring their own pen.
We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

Wearing a mask at the competition venue is **mandatory**.

**Español:**
NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores, sin importar los tiempos de resolución.
* Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). Máximo un acompañante por persona.
* La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Leer toda la información disponible en esta página.

**¡Importante!**

**La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.**

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

**English:**
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 30.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). Only one guest per competitor allowed.
* This competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue.
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* Read all the information available in this website.

**Attention!**

For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

instalaciones del local.
____

The Nazarene Theological Seminary of Peru is an evangelical institution dedicated to the preparation of Christian ministers, and are giving us kindly their facilities for the realization of the tournament, therefore, it is asked to have an appropriate behavior to the Religious Institute. We are allowed to use the place of ceremonies where the tournament will take place, go through the open spaces, and use the bathrooms. But it's forbidden to enter classrooms, offices and any other	of the facilities.

## Estimados competidores debido al incremento de casos Covid-19 la competencia para el 23 de enero será cancelada, ésta será reprogramada para Marzo, lamentamos el inconveniente que pueda ocasionar el cambio, favor coordinar con los organizadores la devolución del dinero si no puede participar en marzo.

**Costa Rica Regresa 2022** será la primera competencia oficial despues de la pandemia en el país.

Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA.

Por tal motivo se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia.
El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.
Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años.
Solo se permitirá un acompañante por persona.
Cada competidor deberá llevar su propio lapicero.
Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio.

**.....................English version...................**

## Due to the increase in Covid-19 cases, the competition for January 23 will be canceled, it will be rescheduled for March.

Costa Rica Regresa 2022 will be the first official competition after the pandemic in the country.

Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA.

For this reason, the temperature will be taken at the entrance of the competition.
The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition.
Vaccination card will be requested from those over 12 years of age. 
We will only allow one companion per person. 
Each competitor must bring their own pen.
We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

items.information:
Popping Off Pukekohe B 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

Please note this is a **twin competition**. To make it fairer and more accessible to more competitiors during the current covid-19 restrictions, you will only be allowed to register for one competition - not both. Please check the event list and timings to see which day you would like to register for as there will be different events on different days.

To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. OR

items.information:
**Español:**
NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución.
* Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local.
* La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.

**¡Importante!**

**La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.**

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

**English:**
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 30.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors.
* Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue.
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.

**Attention!**

**The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.**

For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.**

Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**.

Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16705-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques]https://docs.google.com/document/d/121IA2o1dPWAdlqZNCO0KyVLceeFsbFENTiVlMPThAkU/edit?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA.

Note : **1 accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir.

Note : Dans la cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA cancelle la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs.

**[EN]**

**As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. Also, a welcome questionnaire will have to be filled, see the [Vaccination proof tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16710-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) for more details. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the government updates its regulations.** Moreover, note that **individuals arriving from outside of Canada need to qualify as [fully vaccinated travellers](https://travel.gc.ca/travel-covid/travel-restrictions/covid-vaccinated-travellers-entering-canada) and follow the Canadian government policies detailed on the website.**

Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new conditions** and there are things to be particularly attentive to.

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16705-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/121IA2o1dPWAdlqZNCO0KyVLceeFsbFENTiVlMPThAkU/edit?usp=sharing).

Note: **Only one (1) spectator per competitor** can attend. **If you're not a competitor or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.**

Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in and cancel the competition. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

items.name: Norrkubing 2021
items.information:
This is the 2021 edition of Norrkubing. A competition which history started in 2015, and this is the 6th time a competition has been organized in this municipality. The competition is open to everyone but limited to 25 competitors due to regulations regarding covid-19.

Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the COVID-19 tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub website.

Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses.

-----

Detta är 2021 års upplaga av Norrkubing. Tävlingen arrangerades för första gången år 2015, och detta är den sjätte gången en tävling arrangeras i denna kommun. Tävlingen är öppen för alla men begränsad till maximalt 25 deltagare på grund av restriktioner kring covid-19.

Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken COVID-19, med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs hemsida.

Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter.

venue.name: Walton Elementary School
venue.details: In the gym, with additional space in the nearby foyer and library space as well

items.information:
**As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), all competitors and their (single) guest must provide proof of having received at least one dose of vaccination in order to enter the venue. As such, please do not register unless you will have had at least one dose of a vaccine before the competition date, as otherwise you will not be allowed to enter the venue nor compete. We will send registered competitors further details in an email when the government releases more details.**

Cubing solo over the pandemic has made us only too glad to host an actual, face to face, long awaited gathering for local and perhaps not so local cubers...so welcome to BC Cubing Comeback 2021-either A or B!

We the organizers of [Fraser Valley Open 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FraserValleySpring2018) and [2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FraserValleySpringOpen2019) are thrilled to invite you this time to the heart of Coquitlam for a fun and safe return to cubing, competing and most of all connecting together!

Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new shifts** and there are things to be particularly attentive to.

Note that this is a **one of a pair of twin competitions**. We have not had twin competitions in BC before. Please see the [Twin Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCCubingComebackB2021#16216-twin-competitions) for more information.

A small portion of each registration fee will be in support of the BC Fires Appeal with the Canadian Red Cross. Each dollar we donate will be matched by both the provincial and federal governments. Donations will be used for immediate and ongoing relief efforts as well as for long-term recovery and preparedness. Feel free to check out [the Red Cross page](https://www.redcross.ca/how-we-help/current-emergency-responses/2021-british-columbia-fires) for more information.

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCCubingComebackB2021#16211-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11vtCfK4waavNE_PUpHGQ12mZxPuTA6_Hrbd79cNUhd0/edit?usp=sharing).

Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free.  Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers stay well within WCA recommendations. **If you're not a competitor, or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.**

Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in with the additional ask that all attendees show 1) a negative test prior to venue entry or 2) that they have been fully vaccinated for 2 weeks prior. The WCA reserves the right in the event of a clear 4th wave in BC to cancel the competition outright. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

**Español:**
NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución.
* Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local.
* La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes. Es importante recordar que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás (artículo [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3) del reglamento).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (categoría, no competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.

**¡Importante!**

**La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.**

Ante cualquier duda consultar con el organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

**English:**
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 35.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors if possible.
* Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue. So, please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue.
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.

**Important!**

**The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.**

For any question, contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.name: Flen - Lilla Manschetten 2021

venue.name: [Aktivitetshuset Skjortan](https://flen.se/uppleva-gora/aktivitetshuset-skjortan/)
venue.details: On the second floor, right directly after the stairs.

items.information:
Välkommen till de första tävlingarna att arrangeras i tvillingformat i Sverige! Denna tävling hör ihop med [Flen - Stora Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021), och det är endast tillåtet att anmäla sig och tävla i en av dessa två tävlingar. Mer information om detta finns under fliken [Tvillingtävling](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16202-tvillingtavling-twin-competition). 

Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16171-covid-19), med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs [hemsida](https://svekub.se/). 

Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter.

-----

Welcome to the first ever twin competitions in Sweden! This competition is twinned with [Flen - Stora Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021), and competitors may only register for and compete in one out of these two competitions. More on this can be found under the [Twin competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16202-tvillingtavling-twin-competition) tab.

Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16171-covid-19) tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub [website](https://svekub.se/).

Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses.

venue.address: Hungerford Crescent, Cobham Drive SH1, Hamilton

items.information:
NZ North Island Championship 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2021 is the second regional championship held in New Zealand in the lead up to Nationals later in 2021.

#### Рубик шооны Монгол улсын аварга шалгаруулах албан ёсны нээллтэй тэмцээн
This competition is the official Championship of Mongolia.
Only Mongolian citizens are eligible to win prizes and titles.
The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**COVID-19 цар тахлын улмаас цуцлагдсан байсан Рубик шооны улсын аварга шалгаруулах албан ёсны тэмцээн “Welcome Back Mongolia Championship 2020” гэсэн нэртэйгээр дахин зарлагдаж байна.
Хэрвээ та цуцлагдсан байсан Рубик шооны Улсын аварга шалгаруулах тэмцээнд бүртгүүлсэн бол энэ удаагийн тэмцээнд 50%-ийн хөнгөлөлттэй оролцох боломжтой.**

**Гэхдээ та тэмцээндээ дахин бүртгүүлэх ёстой гэдгийг анхаарна уу!**

**Хэрвээ та энэ удаагийн Рубик шооны улсын аварга шалгаруулах тэмцээнд оролцох боломжгүй болсон тохиолдолд таны төлсөн хураамжны мөнгийг буцаан олгох боломжгүй. Харин таньд үнэ бүхий дурсгалын зүйлс бэлэглэх болно.**

**Бидний нөхцөл байдлыг ойлгож хүлээцтэй хандана уу.**


**The official Mongolia Championship, which was canceled due to the COVID-19 epidemic, is being re-announced under the name "Welcome Back Mongolia Championship 2020".**
**If you have registered for the canceled Mongolia Championship, you can participate in this competiton with a 50% discount.**

**Please note, however, that you must re-register for the competition!**

**If you are unable to participate in this Mongolia Championship, your fee will not be refunded. But you will get valuable souvenirs.**

**Please understand our situation and be patient.**

items.information:
#Tävlingen har ställts in på grund av ökat antal rapporterade fall av COVID-19 i Sverige.#

Välkomna till Svenska Öppna 2020! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 8 sekunder eller 5 minuter.

**Tävlingens upplägg i år är kraftigt modifierat på grund av covid-19 pandemin. Det är endast tillåtet att tävla på en av de två tävlingarna Swedish Open Side Events A eller B. I tillägg till det är det tillåtet att delta på en av tävlingarna Swedish Open Main Events A, B, C eller D. Efterföljs inte detta kommer anmälan till de tävlingar man inte har rätt att kombinera att tas bort.**

Vi ber er för övrigt läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida extra noga eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information, däribland information relaterat till covid-19. 

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, prispengar och titeln Svensk Mästare (utan WCA-status).

-----

Español: La competencia Bisiesto Open 2020 será la cuarta edición que se llevará acabo en este local.
Leer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución.
Los acompañantes de los competidores no tiene que pagar ningún tipo de entrada ni inscripción.
Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento, de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. Por favor tengan también en cuenta los artículos [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) y [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1).

English: The Bisiesto Open 2020 competition will be the fourth edition that will take place in this venue.
Read the [regulations of the WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues.
This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
Guests do not have to pay any type of entry or registration.
Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the regulations. A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns.

Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Registration is open to all, of all nationalities.

Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.

Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.information:
**English:**
CubingAT is happy to announce the first official WCA competition in Salzburg, the Salzburg Open 2020. Fortunately, we found a very strong, dynamic and cool partner (HTBLuVA Salzburg), that finally gave us the possibility to solve some cubes in Salzburg.
The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations.

All guests are welcome, but to maintain the security, we would like you to let us know you’re coming. Simply write us your name to this e-mail address: competitions@cubing.at. Alternatively, if you accompany a competitor, they can write your name in the comment of their registration.
___
**Deutsch:**
Wir von CubingAT freuen uns sehr euch in der HTBLuVA Salzburg, bei den ersten Salzburg Open 2020 begrüßen zu können. Dank der hervorragenden Zusammenarbeit mit dem routinierten, dynamischen und vor allem aufgeschlossenen Team der HTBLuVA, dürfen wir Speedcuber auch endlich mal in Salzburg Würfel (schnell) lösen. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben.

Alle Gäste sind selbstverständlich gerne willkommen, jedoch würden wir euch aus Sicherheitsgründen bitten, uns ein kurzes Mail mit eurem Namen unter der E-Mail competitions@cubing.at zukommen zu lassen. Oder, falls Ihr einen Teilnehmer begleitet, kann Euer Name bei dessen Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld vermerkt werden.
